text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer!
It looks so clean now, doesn't it?

Narita Top Road happily mentions
that her racewear has returned
from the dry cleaners.
choice_data_list: It looks brand new
It looks brand new, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I know, right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Getting dirty might be proof of working hard,
but once the race is over,
I want to make sure I'm neat and clean."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's a little sad
to see this color change, after all...

Prompted by the remark, I look once more at Narita Top Road's
racing outfit—at its colors. Pink and purple,
a gentle hue right in between.
choice_data_list: Why that color?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: You were struggling to decide on the design and colors before, right?
You were struggling to decide on the design and colors before, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um... Y-Yes, that's true.

An Umamusume can also decide on her racewear herself.
Narita Top Road had once agonized over that in the past, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The reason I picked this color was... well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... The design is set, but
I just can't settle on a color.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I really think bright colors suit Class Rep Top Road best!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. I can totally see that~. Any bright color looks great on you~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you think so?
A bright color, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(The colors for my racing silks... I ended up fretting over it
and couldn't get much sleep...
And I have to submit it today, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"A bright color, a bright color... Maybe yellow?
Or perhaps—"
choice_data_list: Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
Fufu, what a coincidence.
Are you out on a morning stroll, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I've always loved the atmosphere at this time of day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what you mean!
It feels so nice out. I just kept running
and ended up all the way out here without realizing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Truly, it feels so good...
The twilight-purple sky paints Narita Top Road in its hues.
choice_data_list: ...Top Road is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: The morning glow suits you.
The morning glow really suits you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(The words the Trainer
said to me back then.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Even when I'm feeling down, seeing the morning glow makes me feel ready to do my best today.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
("I have high hopes for today."
...That's what they said. That's why I...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I decided... that I wanted to run alongside that color.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Actually, you see...
There was someone who told me that this color suits me!

I see. Looking at it again, it really does
suit you well.
After sharing that thought, I continued speaking.
choice_data_list: It looks like the colors of the morning sunrise.
It resembles the colors of the sunrise.
What kind of person are they?

text_block_list.text:
I see. Looking at it again, it really does
suit you well.
After sharing that thought, I continued speaking.
choice_data_list: It looks like the colors of the morning sunrise.
It resembles the colors of the sunrise.
What kind of person are they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.
choice_data_list: Top Road? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No! Come, Trainer-san.
Let us begin our training!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The start of a new day...
Today as well, I shall show you a run that lives up to your expectations, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Are you curious?
choice_data_list: Wait, do I know you?
Is it someone I know, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows~?
Enough about that, end of story!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've decided to keep this memory all to myself!

Narita Top Road gave a mischievous smile
and turned her back.
